WITH window_stats AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS product_category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS window_orders
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
baseline_stats AS (
  SELECT p.product_category_name AS product_category,
         COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS baseline_orders
  FROM orders.orders o
  JOIN orders.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN orders.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
  GROUP BY p.product_category_name
),
window_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-24'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-25'
),
baseline_total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders
  FROM orders.orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-11-17'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-11-24'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(w.product_category, b.product_category) AS product_category,
         COALESCE(w.window_orders, 0) AS window_orders,
         COALESCE(b.baseline_orders, 0) AS baseline_orders,
         ROUND(COALESCE(w.window_orders, 0)::DOUBLE / wt.total_orders, 4) AS window_share,
         ROUND(COALESCE(b.baseline_orders, 0)::DOUBLE / bt.total_orders / 7, 4) AS baseline_daily_share,
         ROUND(COALESCE(w.window_orders, 0)::DOUBLE / wt.total_orders - COALESCE(b.baseline_orders, 0)::DOUBLE / bt.total_orders / 7, 4) AS share_point_change
  FROM window_stats w
  FULL OUTER JOIN baseline_stats b ON w.product_category = b.product_category
  CROSS JOIN window_total wt
  CROSS JOIN baseline_total bt
)
SELECT product_category,
       window_orders,
       baseline_orders,
       window_share,
       baseline_daily_share,
       share_point_change
FROM combined
ORDER BY ABS(share_point_change) DESC
LIMIT 20;
